title: AgentOPSD：turn-level credit 账（递归信念更新 + ΔB 边际信用 + bounded multiplier 优势重塑）
title_en: AgentOPSD: Turn-Level Credit Ledger (Recursive Belief Update + ΔB Marginal Credit + Bounded Multiplier Advantage Reshaping)
source_lines: advantages.py 全文件（AgentOPSDConfig / group_sequence_advantages / _sigmoid / reshape_turn_advantages / assign_agentopsd_advantages）+ teacher.py::_score_turns + loss.py::build_agentopsd_ppo_datum
description: AgentOPSD 的核心主张：GRPO 把序列级 advantage 广播到轨迹里所有 action token，长程 ALFWorld 轨迹里前面的绕路和最后的关键动作一起被鼓励——token 级 teacher-student logprob gap 本身也不该直接当 credit，**真正决定 credit 的是该 gap 在历史累积信念上的边际变化**。官方 advantages.py 的确定性账（pytrio/Trajectory 依赖全部入参化：步级 logprob、action token 区间、终局奖励均为显式入参），五入口复刻：group——组内 GRPO 序列优势 (r−mean)/(std(ddof=0)+ε)，返回**未 clip 的组均值奖励**作 initial belief；score——Teacher 轨迹 = 换技能前缀后拼同一条 student 后缀，前缀长度差 prefix_offset 平移全部 action 区间，每 turn evidence = Σ(teacher_lp − student_lp)，zip 截断语义；reshape——信念递推账：b0 = clip(belief, ε, 1−ε)、c_k = γ·c_{k-1} + e_k（c_0=0）、B_k = σ(logit(b0) + c_k)，outcome_credit = sign(A_seq)·(B_k − B_{k-1})，组内标准化后 weight = clip(1 + b·z, 1−b, 1+b)，A_turn = A_seq·((1−λ) + λ·w)，零优势轨迹 sign=0 → credit 全 0、weight 全 1；assign——按 group_id 分组算序列优势 + 退化组统计（全 |adv| ≤ ε）+ zip(steps, turns) 截断写回每 step；ppo——全 token 先填 0，按 zip(steps, credits) 把 old_logprob 与该 turn 的 advantage 广播到 action 区间，再右移对齐（input=tokens[:-1]、target=tokens[1:]、logprobs/advantages 取 [1:]），sequence_advantage == 0 的轨迹不进训练。
description_en: AgentOPSD's core claim: GRPO broadcasts the sequence-level advantage to every action token in a trajectory — in long-horizon ALFWorld rollouts the early detours and the final key action get encouraged together — and the raw token-level teacher-student logprob gap should not be the credit either: **what determines credit is the marginal change of that gap on the accumulated belief history**. This problem replicates the deterministic accounting of the official advantages.py (pytrio/Trajectory dependencies fully parameterized: per-step logprobs, action token ranges, and final rewards are all explicit inputs) via five solve entries: group — the GRPO sequence advantage (r−mean)/(std(ddof=0)+ε) returning the **unclipped group mean reward** as the initial belief; score — the teacher trajectory = swap the skill prefix and append the same student suffix, the prefix-length difference shifts every action range, each turn's evidence = Σ(teacher_lp − student_lp) with zip-truncation semantics; reshape — the belief-recursion ledger: b0 = clip(belief, ε, 1−ε), c_k = γ·c_{k-1} + e_k (c_0=0), B_k = σ(logit(b0) + c_k), outcome_credit = sign(A_seq)·(B_k − B_{k-1}), group-standardized then weight = clip(1 + b·z, 1−b, 1+b), A_turn = A_seq·((1−λ) + λ·w); a zero-advantage trajectory gets sign=0 → all-zero credits, all-one weights; assign — group by group_id, sequence advantages + degenerate-group stats (all |adv| ≤ ε) + zip(steps, turns) truncated write-back per step; ppo — fill zeros over all tokens, broadcast old_logprob and the turn's advantage into action ranges by zip(steps, credits), then right-shift align (input=tokens[:-1], target=tokens[1:], logprobs/advantages taken from [1:]); trajectories with sequence_advantage == 0 are excluded from training.
notes: 官方账的关键细节（沙箱实测钉死）：(1) **initial belief 是未 clip 的组均值奖励**：group_sequence_advantages 返回 (advantages, mean_reward)，clip 只发生在 reshape 内部（[ε, 1−ε]）——initial_belief=1.0 时 b0=1−1e-4、=0.0 时 b0=1e-4，logit 用 log(b0/(1−b0))。(2) 证据递推 c_0=0：首轮 cumulative = γ·0 + e_0 = e_0，belief_before 链式推进（第 k turn 的 before 是第 k−1 turn 的 after）——不是每个 turn 独立从 b0 出发。(3) **outcome_credit = sign(A_seq)·(B_k − B_{k-1})**：sign(0)=0，所以零优势轨迹 credit 全 0、z=(0−0)/(0+ε)=0、weight=1、A_turn=A_seq×((1−λ)+λ·1)=0——evidence 仍算但被 sign 门整体清零；负优势轨迹 sign=−1 把负 delta 翻正（credit 仍可正可负，取决于 delta 符号）。(4) weight 的三段账：z = (credit−mean)/(std(ddof=0)+ε)、w = clip(1 + b·z, 1−b, 1+b)（默认 b=0.2 → [0.8, 1.2]）、multiplier = (1−λ) + λ·w（默认 λ=0.5 → [0.9, 1.1]）——**credit 只重分配幅度、不反转方向**（multiplier 恒正）。(5) score_turns 的 prefix_offset = teacher_initial_length − student_initial_length：teacher 前缀换了技能提示更长，全部 action 区间平移 +offset；每 turn evidence 是 zip(numeric, student_logprobs) 求和——teacher 切片短于 student logprobs 时按短侧截断（官方依赖二者等长，截断语义是隐式行为）。(6) assign 的退化组判定在写回之前：all(|adv| ≤ ε)（全同奖励 → std=0 → adv=(r−mean)/(0+ε)=0）；zip(trajectory.steps, credit.turns) 截断写回——steps 少于 evidences 时只填前缀。(7) ppo 数组的两处 0 填充：非 action token 的 old_logprob 与 advantage 都是 0；右移对齐后 position p 的标签是 token p+1（input=tokens[:-1]、target=tokens[1:]、logprobs/advantages 都取 [1:]）——**最后一个 action token 的 logprob 落在 index−1 处不被丢弃**，因为 advantages_by_token 比全 token 短一位对齐。(8) build_training_datums 过滤 sequence_advantage != 0.0：退化组整组不进训练（与 GRPO 零梯度语义一致）。(9) 与 to-grpo-advantage 划界：那题是 advantage 侧的组内标准化本身；本题标准化之后还有信念递推 + 边际信用 + bounded multiplier 三层重塑，且 credit 粒度从序列降到 turn。(10) 与 784 VinePPO 划界：VinePPO 用 MC 回报估计替代价值网（每步 k 条续采），本题不采样、只做一次 teacher forward 的 logprob 差账。
notes_en: Key official details (pinned by sandbox runs): (1) **the initial belief is the unclipped group mean reward**: group_sequence_advantages returns (advantages, mean_reward), the clip happens only inside reshape ([ε, 1−ε]) — initial_belief=1.0 gives b0=1−1e-4 and 0.0 gives b0=1e-4, logit = log(b0/(1−b0)). (2) The evidence recursion starts from c_0=0: the first turn's cumulative = γ·0 + e_0 = e_0, and belief_before advances as a chain (turn k's before is turn k−1's after) — not restarted from b0 per turn. (3) **outcome_credit = sign(A_seq)·(B_k − B_{k-1})**: sign(0)=0, so a zero-advantage trajectory gets all-zero credits, z=(0−0)/(0+ε)=0, weight=1, and A_turn = A_seq×((1−λ)+λ·1)=0 — evidence is still computed but zeroed wholesale by the sign gate; a negative-advantage trajectory's sign=−1 flips negative deltas positive (credits stay signed by the delta). (4) The weight is a three-stage account: z = (credit−mean)/(std(ddof=0)+ε), w = clip(1 + b·z, 1−b, 1+b) (default b=0.2 → [0.8, 1.2]), multiplier = (1−λ) + λ·w (default λ=0.5 → [0.9, 1.1]) — **credit only redistributes magnitude and never flips direction** (the multiplier stays positive). (5) score_turns' prefix_offset = teacher_initial_length − student_initial_length: the teacher prefix (with the skill prompt) is longer, so every action range shifts by +offset; each turn's evidence sums zip(numeric, student_logprobs) — when the teacher slice is shorter than the student logprobs it truncates on the shorter side (official data keeps them equal; the truncation semantics are implicit behavior). (6) assign's degenerate-group check runs before the write-back: all(|adv| ≤ ε) (equal rewards → std=0 → adv=(r−mean)/(0+ε)=0); zip(trajectory.steps, credit.turns) write-back truncates — fewer steps than evidences fills only the prefix. (7) Two zero-fills in the ppo arrays: non-action tokens carry 0 for both old_logprob and advantage; after the right shift the label at position p is token p+1 (input=tokens[:-1], target=tokens[1:], logprobs/advantages taken from [1:]) — **the last action token's logprob lands at index−1 and is not dropped** because advantages_by_token aligns one position earlier than the full token list. (8) build_training_datums filters sequence_advantage != 0.0: a degenerate group enters training whole-group-excluded (consistent with GRPO's zero-gradient semantics). (9) Boundary vs to-grpo-advantage: that problem is the group standardization itself on the advantage side; this one adds three reshaping layers after standardization (belief recursion + marginal credit + bounded multiplier) and drops the credit granularity from sequence to turn. (10) Boundary vs 784 VinePPO: VinePPO replaces the value net with MC return estimates (k continuations per step); this problem samples nothing — one teacher forward and a logprob-difference ledger.
